protocol.process_isolation: one child per mode/operation; warmups and samples share that child
protocol.input_staging: the original input is copied once outside timing into a private read-only staged file; all path-backed samples reopen that snapshot; full-file staging and post-run SHA-256 verification are outside elapsed_ns, warm the page cache, and do not measure cold or physical I/O

semantics.facade_parity: open/list exact with source projection; selected-cell API unavailable
